title: 3 Major Isekai You Can Only Watch on HIDIVE
content:
HIDIVE has earned its reputation as an anime streaming platform, and these three exclusive isekai titles prove it. Choosing an anime streaming platform and a genre can be overwhelming, especially in this modern era, where new streaming platforms and genres seem to emerge almost every now and then. However, some combinations can always work.

Isekai has long been one of the oldest and most popular genres in the anime world, with countless titles available to watch. With such an abundance of choices, finding the right anime can be difficult. However, pairing the genre with a streaming platform like HIDIVE gives fans a more selective range of isekai titles to explore, and these three exclusives are proof of that.

3) Reincarnated as a Sword

Almost all isekai anime feature a protagonist who wakes up in a new world inside a powerful body. However, Reincarnated as a Sword , as its title suggests, does things very differently by having its protagonist reincarnated as a weapon. The sword is picked up by Fran, a slave girl who has long been abused by the Beastman Tribe. Fran and the Sword develop a teacher-student bond, as the sword, which can influence Fran’s thoughts, helps the young girl navigate her difficult life.

One of the primary reasons to watch this anime, besides its arguably most interesting premise, is that Reincarnated as a Sword is currently airing its second season as of this writing. With a good production team behind its making, fans looking for an ongoing isekai anime that is exclusively available on HIDIVE should definitely consider Reincarnated as a Sword this fall.

2) Farming Life in Another World

Even more unique than Reincarnated as a Sword is another exclusive title that fans can only watch on HIDIVE: Farming Life in Another World . There is hardly another series quite like this one. As its title suggests, the anime follows a protagonist who simply wants to spend his time farming. This motivation stems from a man who died young in the real world after suffering from a terminal illness that left him bedridden. Taking pity on his short and difficult life, a deity gives him a second chance to live however he wants. However, the protagonist chooses a quiet life and is granted an overpowered tool to help him farm.

The plot eventually expands beyond farming, but everything remains centered around his ability to cultivate the land. Set in a fantasy realm filled with monsters, Hiraku, the protagonist, eventually starts building an empire with a diverse population, something that almost every isekai features but in a unique way. The series has also recently released its second season, which is available exclusively on HIDIVE . If a quieter yet intriguing isekai is what fans are looking for, there is hardly a better choice than Farming Life in Another World right now.

1) The Eminence in Shadow

The Eminence in Shadow is one of the most quintessential isekai anime, and it owes much of its appeal to its overarching fictional plot. The protagonist of this isekai is reincarnated into a magical world with overwhelming powers, where he gets to live out his fantasy of becoming the mastermind behind a fictional world. Cid does whatever he wants, from establishing an evil organization that follows him to fighting against this very organization, even setting up a force to oppose it. However, unbeknownst to Cid, every plot he comes up with starts becoming reality, and political schemes begin to unfold under his name.

It is one of the major isekai anime, with a total of 22 episodes spread across two seasons, both featuring high-quality animation. Now, a new movie for The Eminence in Shadow has also been announced, with a planned 2027 release. This only further proves that The Eminence in Shadow is one of the biggest isekai anime titles that fans can watch exclusively on HIDIVE.

title: Drama Queen Manga Ends in 4 Chapters
content:
Kuraku Ichikawa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that their Drama Queen manga will end in four chapters.

MANGA Plus publishes the series in English and describes the story:

Hate brings pain to the world. After saving the earth, aliens have taken up residence with the humans in Japan. Nomamoto, a factory worker with an abusive alien boss, one day meets Kitami, who tells her his own family was killed by aliens. The two quickly forge a friendship, but one day Kitami does the unthinkable...

Ichikawa launched the series on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in December 2024. Shueisha shipped the seventh compiled book volume on September 4.

title: Trigun Anime Gets New Novel This Winter
content:
The autumn issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. RISE magazine announced on Thursday that the Trigun franchise will get a new novel written in collaboration between series creator Yasuhiro Nightow and Trigun Stampede writer Takehiko Oxi titled Trigun Manuscript this winter. The series will be based on the world of the Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargaze anime.

The Trigun Stargaze anime premiered on TV Tokyo and its affiliated channels on January 10. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, along with an English dub .

Trigun Stargaze is the previously announced " final phase " of the Trigun Stampede anime , set 2.5 years after the end of Trigun Stampede .

Trigun Stampede premiered in Japan in January 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired and is also streaming an English dub .

Madhouse 's previous television anime adaptation aired for 26 episodes in Japan in 1998. The anime launched in North America for home video in 2000. Geneon Entertainment (formerly Pioneer ) originally released the series on DVD, but Funimation has since licensed the series and released it on Blu-ray Disc and DVD. The series is now streaming on Crunchyroll following Sony 's Funimation Global Group 's acquisition of Crunchyroll from AT&T. Cartoon Network 's Adult Swim programming block aired the anime in 2003.

The Trigun anime adapts Yasuhiro Nightow 's manga of the same name. The manga ran in Tokuma Shoten 's Monthly Shonen Captain magazine from 1995 to 1997. The manga returned with Trigun Maximum in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine later in 1997 and ran until 2007. Dark Horse Comics has released the manga in English.

The Trigun: Badlands Rumble anime film debuted in April 2010 and was the first new Trigun animation in over a decade.

title: Crunchyroll Releases New English Dub for Two Legendary Shonen Jump Movies After 21 Years
content:
The two classic Shonen Jump movies got their anticipated English dub release by Crunchyroll. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized several legendary manga series, most of which ended up getting their anime adaptations. The same goes for the timeless classic, The Prince of Tennis , written and illustrated by Takeshi Konomi. While the anime made its return in September this year as part of the Fall 2026 anime lineup , Crunchyroll released the English dub of The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe and The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game . Both movies were originally released on January 29th, 2005, but fans only had access to the Japanese audio with English subtitles until now.

These short movies added their English dub on October 14th, 2026. While Crunchyroll didn’t officially announce the release, @AnimeDubUpdates on X spotted it and shared it with fans. While A Gift from Otobe is only 30 minutes long, the other movie has double the runtime, and they were both co-aired in the theatres in Japan before getting their worldwide streaming release. Neither of these movies is considered canon since they don’t officially adapt the source material, but considering their critical acclaim, they’re both a must-watch for every fan.

The Prince of Tennis II Made Its Comeback This Year With a New Season

The Prince of Tennis II U-17 World Cup: Final Member Selection Match is the latest season of the anime , and the first installment since the manga’s conclusion. The Final Member Selection Match premiered on Crunchyroll on September 30th, 2026, and it has released five episodes so far. The anime is streaming across the regions of North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, and the Indian subcontinent. Along with the subbed release date, the platform also released the English dub, which is two weeks behind the original schedule. The latest season is scheduled for 13 episodes, after which we can expect to know more about what the studio has planned for the anime’s future. Fans can also catch up to the previous seasons that are streaming on the platform. The anime is returning after two years with better visuals and production as the story heads closer to its ending.

The Prince of Tennis II Anime Isn’t Ending Anytime Soon

The manga originally began serialization in 2009 and ended in 2008, but it took only one year for Konomi to return with a sequel in Shueisha’s Jump Square magazine. The Prince of Tennis II reached its conclusion in 2024 , marking the end of this long-running franchise. While the main story in the manga is already over, the anime still has a huge chunk of story left to adapt. The Semifinal primarily focuses on the match against the German national team as they try to reach the finals for the first time in Japan’s tennis history. Additionally, the latest season directly picks up from where the story left off as the Team Japan players face off against their old rivals to earn spots in the lineup for the World Cup final.

title: Television Producer/Distributor Sandy Frank Dies at 97
content:
Frank was born on July 11, 1929. Frank started his career as a sales executive for Paramount Pictures in the late 1940s, then worked at Guild Films and NBC before becoming President of Worldwide Sales at Wrather Corporation. In 1964, he started his own television program syndication company Sandy Frank Program Sales. In 1978, he expanded his company's operations and renamed it Sandy Frank Entertainment .

Frank's company is known for producing and distributing game shows such as Name That Tune , The Dating Game , and Face the Music .

Through his company, Frank produced and distributed Battle of the Planets , the English U.S. adaptation of the Kagaku Ninja-Tai Gatchaman anime, in 1978. He later worked on the G-Force: Guardians of Space adaptation of Gatchaman . His company also distributed and dubbed Japanese Daiei Film monster movies.

title: 3 Iconic Dragon Ball Moments Every Vegeta Fan Needs to Revisit
content:
Dragon Ball ‘ s favorite bad boy turned good in Saiyan Prince Vegeta showed time and time again why his story is one of the best in all of anime. The egotistical, murderous, evil Saiyan left all those negative traits to become a lovable family man and protector of the Earth alongside Goku . Vegeta is the archetype for dynamic television characters.

It certainly helps that the series has continued for more than four decades. It’s allowed the story and characters to continue growing from the original premise. Vegeta’s arc never felt forced either. His story featured tiny steps of positive progress along the way. Still, there were definitive moments that hit the viewer hard on his change from villain to hero that you’ll find below.

3) Joining Goku For The Greater Good During the Majin Buu Saga

The final conflict of Dragon Ball Z pushes Vegeta to the brink of his Saiyan pride. Super Buu decimated his family and friends. He and Goku wanted to defeat the monster together without having to fuse with each other. After a beatdown by Buu, the duo realizes they have to set their differences aside. Not surprisingly, Goku is the first to realize that, and Vegeta takes a little more convincing.

Eventually, he acquiesces and fuses with his rival to create Vegito . The duo dominates Super Buu in a one-on-one fight and begins the eventual downfall of the monster. Buu absorbs the fused Saiyans, winning the fight but losing the war in the process. Vegeta and Goku free their fellow fighters and as a result cut into Buu’s power level. Once they escaped, Goku eventually defeats a lesser Kid Buu with a Spirit Bomb. The win wouldn’t have happened if Vegeta didn’t set aside his pride and join with his once-hated rival.

2) Showing Selfless Saiyan Pride During the Tournament of Power

One trait that’s remained strong throughout Vegeta’s heroic turn is his Saiyan pride. It’s gone from a bit more of a selfish one to a love for his people, even if they’re not from the same universe. A trait that was on display more than ever when Vegeta promised to bring back Cabba and Universe 6 if they were destroyed in the Tournament of Power.

It’s a moment of true mercy and not something that Vegeta would’ve said when he first came to Earth. His only focus back then was on himself, avenging Planet Vegeta and becoming the most powerful being in the universe. Universe 7 goes on to win the Tournament of Power, and Android 17 asks for all the destroyed universes to be restored. In the scene, Vegeta cracks a small smile when 17 says his wish, knowing that his apprentice will be back.

1) Vegeta’s Finds His Salvation During the Majin Buu Arcs

There’s no greater moment of character transition than Vegeta’s fatal sacrifice to save his family and friends. His attempt to overtake Goku’s power by accepting dark magic from Babidi and becoming Majin Vegeta proved to be a huge mistake. Vegeta faced the impossible after taking a beating from Buu and realized he could not defeat him without sacrificing himself.

Not long after this, he’s told by Piccolo that he would not be sent to the same place as Goku did in the afterlife. It’s not outright said the place, but from deduction, Vegeta would be sent to Hell for his transgressions. Faced with this morbid information, the once extremely prideful Saiyan still faced his impending death and afterlife sentence with a smirk and, “I see – that’s too bad.” He then moved forward with the plan to blow himself up hoping it would eliminate Buu too.

Although the move doesn’t work, it’s far from a waste when it comes to the Saiyan’s character. Vegeta essentially redeems his soul by trying selflessly to defeat Buu. It also says a lot because the move costs him his original life goal, to become the strongest Saiyan in existence and surpass Goku. From here, a new Vegeta surfaced. Although he’s still rough around the edges, his heart is in the right place when any world-saving situation arises. What do you think about the list? Let us know in the comments.

title: Shaman King Creator Returns for Surprise New Anime – Watch Trailer
content:
Hiroyuki Takei is returning with a brand new anime project this month, and it’s going to be one of his most unique works so far. Shaman King may not have received the anime adaptation it deserved, but it remains one of the most beloved Shonen Jump series of all time. The manga received an anime adaptation in the 1990s and eventually released a reboot as well. Unfortunately, neither adaptation could do justice to the exceptional story. The creator, Hiroyuki Takei, has been working in the industry for almost three decades, releasing several manga series and even providing original character design for acclaimed anime shows.

Takei is returning with yet another exciting project, and this time, it will be a web anime rather than a television broadcast. The details were officially shared a week ago on the official X handle of the anime . The upcoming anime, titled Mecha Samurai , marks Takei’s return as the original character designer three years after the release of his latest work, Bikkurimen . The title of Takei’s upcoming series is more than enough to confirm it’s going to be another unique project by him. With the release date closer than ever, the anime also launched an official website to reveal the character designs, introduction to the story, teasers, PVs, and more.

Where to Watch Mecha Samurai ?

Mecha Samurai is officially listed as a web anime rather than a TV series, which means it won’t broadcast on any Japanese networks. Instead of getting a streaming release on major platforms such as Crunchyroll and Netflix , it will be available on the official YouTube channel of Mecha Samurai and the designated social media platforms. Produced by Plott and TV Tokyo, the anime short will officially debut this month, although the exact release date and time will be announced at a later date. It’s only been a week since the announcement, but fans have already got a first glimpse at the story with the official promotional video introducing the characters. The official website also shared the main cast, namely, Chiaki Kuzumi (voiced by Kentaro Mashiro), Sana Fujimiya (voiced by Riona Yamashita), Kiyoharu Obana (voiced by Ayumu Mizukami), and Kaoru Rindo (voiced by Masaaki Mizunaka).

What Is the Plot of Mecha Samurai ?

The story takes place in the modern world where mysterious portals known as Kimon have suddenly appeared all across Japan. These portals lead to another world, from which powerful mechanical monsters called Yokai have begun emerging. These monsters attack the innocent citizens, leaving death and destruction in their wake. In order to stop their rampage, a special organization called Samurai has been formed, with each member possessing a skill unique to them. They wield special katana that are far different from any traditional Japanese blade. These katana wield supernatural powers suited for battling these mechanical creatures. The story primarily centers around Chiaki Kuzumi, a young man and a Samurai whose katana is imbued with the power of the very Yokai he is supposed to kill.

Are you excited to see Takei’s return with a brand-new anime? What are your expectations for the anime after watching the trailer? Share your thoughts in the comments!

The story takes place in the modern world where mysterious portals known as Kimon have suddenly appeared all across Japan. These portals lead to another world, from which powerful mechanical monsters called Yokai have begun emerging. These monsters attack the innocent citizens, leaving death and destruction in their wake. In order to stop their rampage, a special organization called Samurai has been formed, with each member possessing a skill unique to them. They wield special katana that are far different from any traditional Japanese blade. These katana wield supernatural powers suited for battling these mechanical creatures. The story primarily centers around Chiaki Kuzumi, a young man and a Samurai whose katana is imbued with the power of the very Yokai he is supposed to kill.
Are you excited to see Takei’s return with a brand-new anime? What are your expectations for the anime after watching the trailer? Share your thoughts in the comments!

title: All-Female Troupe Takarazuka Revue to Perform Musical for My Happy Marriage Series
content:
The musical stars Sea Towaki as Kiyoka and Misaki Hoshizora as Miyo.

Daisuke Tabuchi is directing the musical.

The musical will run alongside the TAKARAZUKA SPECTACULAR『MANHATTAN FOLLIES』－Seize The Day－ show.

The My Happy Marriage television anime adaptation's first season premiered in July 2023 with 12 episodes. Netflix also began streaming the anime worldwide in July 2023. The eighth novel volume bundled an original anime titled " Shiawase no Katachi " (The Shape of Happiness) on Blu-ray Disc when it shipped in March 2024. The OVA also streamed simultaneously worldwide on Netflix and other streaming services in November 2024, on "Good Couples Day" in Japan.

The second season premiered in January 2025 on Tokyo MX , BS11 , KBS Kyoto , Sun TV , TV Aichi , and on AT-X . Netflix and other services also began streaming the season at the same time it premiered on broadcast television.

An anime special aired on TV Tokyo and other stations on October 25 at 7:00 p.m. JST, and streamed on Netflix and other services starting on the same day at 8:30 p.m. JST. All three episodes premiered on the same day.

Agitogi and Tsukioka launched the novel series in January 2019. Yen Press licensed the light novels, and it describes the story:

Born to a noble family, Miyo is raised by her abusive stepmother and married off to Kiyoka, a soldier so heartless his prior fiancées fled within three days into their engagement. With no home to return to, Miyo slowly starts to open her heart to her cold and pale husband-to-be, despite their rocky introduction... This might just be her chance at finding true love and happiness.

Rito Kohsaka 's manga adaptation debuted on Square Enix 's Gangan Online website in December 2018. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga physically and digitally in English.

A live-action film adaptation of the novels opened in Japan in March 2023. The film ranked at #1 in its opening weekend, and sold 479,700 tickets to earn 654 million yen (about US$4.97 million) in its first three days.

title: Dragon Ball Super Just Got a Disappointing Sign for the Manga’s Return
content:
Dragon Ball Super fans have been hoping to see the manga release return with new chapters ever since it went on hiatus back in 2024 , but unfortunately a new update for Jump Festa 2027 makes it seem like the manga might be even further away than fans could hope for. Following the passing of late franchise creator Akira Toriyama, the Dragon Ball Super manga had stalled with an indefinite hiatus. But there’s always been hope that it could return for more even without the creator’s input.

Dragon Ball Super was already raising eyebrows as it was revealed to not be having any kind of stage presence during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event later this year , and had been missing from the promotional poster for the event. But it seems like even Dragon Ball Supe r’s manga is missing out on the event too as Dragon Ball Super won’t be represented during the event’s official art gallery either as it’s now been replaced by Metaphor: ReFantazio ( spotted by @SupaChronicles on X ) on the event’s website.

One of the best aspects of Jump Festa each year is the special art gallery where creators from various works contribute a special sketch for the occasion. Despite being on hiatus for the last two years, Dragon Ball Super artist Toyotaro has contributed in the past with special sketches. There’s a chance the same could happen this year too, but there’s something to be said about having the manga removed from this gallery. It means that Dragon Ball Super is basically skipping out on Jump Festa outside of merchandise . It’s a bad sign for those waiting for more of the manga.

Dragon Ball Super has quite a lot to showcase this year too with the release of its remake anime series, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , and a brand new anime now in the works, Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol. Coupled with the lack of any new information about Dragon Ball Super ‘s manga continuation for the past two years, and its potential absence from a major Shueisha event like this is potentially doom for any hope of the manga’s return yet.

Is Dragon Ball Super ‘s Manga Over?

Dragon Ball Super is in a weird place with the manga. The story has technically come to an end with its take on Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero , and it was the final bit of materials overseen by Akira Toriyama before his death. But with the anime now adapting the first of the manga’s two exclusive arcs, Galactic Patrol Prisoner, it once again means the franchise is incomplete as the future events of the series are on a huge cliffhanger teasing more from Black Frieza in the future.

Toyotaro himself has been open about his intent and desire to return to Dragon Ball Super to continue the story without Toriyama, and there’s plenty of ways to do so with Black Frieza still lingering over the rest of Universe 7. If the anime gets to adapt both of these arcs over the next few years and the manga has yet to return for its monthly chapter releases by then, there might be no hope for its future overall. Which is the worst case scenario for fans, but what do you think? Do you want to see Dragon Ball Super’ s manga continue? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – @SupaChronicles on X

title: Recording/Sound Mixer Yoshio Obara Dies
content:
Recording Engineer and sound mixer Yoshio Obara died on October 28.

Obara served as a Recording Engineer and sound mixer on many anime, including In This Corner of the World (pictured right), Summer Wars , The Girl Who Leapt Through Time , Wolf Children , Dragon Ball Daima , Neon Genesis Evangelion , Little Witch Academia , Komi Can't Communicate , FLCL Alternative , FLCL Progressive , Knights of Ramune & 40 , Love Hina , Saber Marionette J , Slayers Revolution , and Slayers Evolution-R .
